lessons_used: Preset fast-track adoption flows, moving sign-in after pet adoption, photo quality callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views were helpful.

Spotlight welcome layouts, background notification prompts, account sync banners, post-adoption certificate sign-in placement, desktop diagnostic flows, playful starter hubs, and carousel choice card layouts showed no clear effect.
Path decision speed helper callouts performed worse than the control.
Predictions were too low for photo quality callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views.
Predictions were too high for preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in reordering, tests with no clear effect, and changes that worsened performance.

Spotlight welcome layouts, background notification prompts, account sync banners, subsequent sign-in reorders, desktop diagnostic flows, playful starter hubs, carousel path layouts, and desktop overlay hints showed no clear effect.
